architecture:
System: Case-Management-096
Primary NIST family: Media Protection (MP); evidence focus: MP-6.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: access to removable and backup media is restricted to specifically authorized custodians. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
